links.outcome: Discrimination (AUROC/AUPRC) of physicians, structured ML model, and LLMs predicting 30-day ED visits/admissions on same cases
links.effect: CLMBR-T AUROC 0.79 (AUPRC 0.78), large LLMs AUROC 0.74, pooled physicians AUROC 0.65 (AUPRC 0.61). LLMs beat physicians but trailed the ML model.
links.quote: CLMBR-T achieved the highest discriminative performance (AUROC 0.79, 95% CI: 0.75-0.83; AUPRC 0.78, 95% CI: 0.72-0.83), followed by large LLMs (DeepSeek V3, Claude 4.1 Opus, GPT-5; AUROC 0.74).

unlisted_practices: Hybrid approach pairing ML risk screening with LLM-generated explanations

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of predictive risk models (CLMBR-T), large language models, and 35 clinicians on synthetic clinical vignettes, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
